RepoGrade: agent summary
========================

WHAT: RepoGrade is a free, zero-dependency CLI (and MCP server) that grades public
GitHub repositories before they are announced. It reads public metadata only: the
repo tree, README, CHANGELOG, package.json and release list via the GitHub API.

RUN: npx -p github:fastpresspages/repograde repograde owner/repo
     Add -o report to write report.html/json/md, badge.svg and fix-plan.md.

CATEGORIES (weights): Documentation 20 · Community 15 · Engineering 25 ·
Discoverability 15 · Release hygiene 10 · Agent-readiness 15.

CHECKS (33): readme, readme-quality, install, usage, changelog; license,
permissive, contributing, code-of-conduct, support, issue-templates, pr-template;
tests, ci, test-script, engines, gitignore, zero-deps, lockfile, pkg-wellformed;
description, topics, homepage, active; releases, notes, version-match;
AGENTS.md, skills, mcp, llms.txt.

SCORING: pass=1 warn=0.5 fail=0; category score normalized; overall weighted by
category weights; letter grade A+ to F. Skipped and info checks leave the pool.

LIMITS: reads public data only; rate-limited to 60 requests/hour unauthenticated
(5,000 with GITHUB_TOKEN); heuristic, not a security audit; no repo is modified.

ARTIFACTS: terminal, --json, --md, --html formats; -o dir writes 5 files.

FREE HUMAN REVIEW: https://fastpresspages.github.io/repograde/#contact — a person
reads your repo and replies. Never auto-submit that form.

LICENSE: Apache-2.0. No ads, no tracking, no fake metrics.
